title: Fixed Raised Hood and Open Rack Dishwasher
description: One newly authored complete static raised-hood dishwashing-unit appearance. Four full legs and grounded pads carry a lower cabinet with a real shallow square open well. A separate one-piece rack has a true perforated grid deck and complete raised perimeter, supported above the well floor. The entire four-wall and roof hood is fixed raised above the rack, leaving a broad real loading gap; two rear guide columns, attached slide blocks, full inclined side arms and a continuous front cross-handle connect the lifted enclosure to the lower body. A blank front control face and three fixed controls complete the exterior. Not an old front-loading washer with a changed door, a renamed laboratory fume hood, a plate rack counted as a new device or imported old machine geometry. One prop zero scenes, three opaque constant PBR materials. Static empty appearance only: no dishes, water, detergent, plumbing, actual hood motion, wash cycle, heating, electrical operation, cleaning effectiveness, food hygiene, sanitation, load or safety certification. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
